questions.question: Use the commutative and associative properties to work out 1 998 + 5 467 + 2 002 the easy way.
questions.expected_answer: Group 1 998 and 2 002 first, because they make 4 000. Then 4 000 + 5 467 = 9 467.

questions.question: Show that subtraction is not associative using 100, 50 and 20.
questions.expected_answer: (100 − 50) − 20 = 50 − 20 = 30, but 100 − (50 − 20) = 100 − 30 = 70. The answers are different, so changing the grouping changes the answer.

questions.question: Use the distributive property to work out 6 × 235.
questions.expected_answer: Split 235 into 200, 30 and 5, then multiply each part: 6 × 200 = 1 200; 6 × 30 = 180; 6 × 5 = 30. Adding the parts: 1 200 + 180 + 30 = 1 410.
